name: Ayurmana (Kumarakom Lake Resort)
tagline: Heritage Ayurvedic spa beside Vembanad Lake
summary: Ayurmana is the heritage Ayurvedic centre at Kumarakom Lake Resort, housed in a restored nalukettu beside Vembanad Lake, offering classical therapies and Panchakarma under qualified physicians.
description: Ayurmana is the heritage Ayurveda retreat of Kumarakom Lake Resort, built around a carefully reassembled 200‑year‑old Chathamangalattu Mana (nalukettu). It frames classical Kerala treatments in an authentic wooden mansion on the banks of Vembanad Lake.

The centre runs physician‑led programmes — Panchakarma, rejuvenation and specialised therapy packages — and uses traditional medicated oils and procedures administered by trained therapists. The resort presents Ayurveda inside a luxury heritage setting.

Visitors come to Ayurmana for week‑long Panchakarma courses, short rejuvenation stays, or single sessions (Abhyanga, Kizhi, herbal dhara treatments). Treatments aim to detox, rebalance doshas and restore energy while you stay at the resort beside the backwaters.
highlights: Housed in an authentic 200‑year‑old Nalukettu (Chathamangalattu Mana)
Green‑Leaf / Kerala Department listings and hospitality awards for the resort
Therapies use classical medicated oils and local Ayurvedic herbs
Backwater setting on Vembanad Lake beside Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary

sections.heading: Background
body: Ayurmana preserves the traditional ambience of a Kerala manor: the resort reassembled the Chathamangalattu Mana (a family home of Ayurvedic practitioners) to create the therapy centre. The property and programmes emphasise classical lineage and Kerala rituals as presented by the resort.

sections.heading: What to see and do
body: Choose from physician‑prescribed Panchakarma courses (multi‑day detox and purification), shorter rejuvenation and beauty therapies, or signature oil massages. The Ayurmana pages list specific programmes and sequence‑based Panchakarma plans for multi‑night stays.
Combine therapies with resort activities: boat rides on Vembanad Lake, birdwatching at nearby Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary, and evenings in the heritage grounds for a calm, restorative experience.

sections.heading: Plan your visit
body: Treatments are best booked with at least several days’ notice; Panchakarma programmes typically start from a week and require initial consultation with the on‑site Ayurvedic physician. Confirm package availability and validity directly with the resort before you travel.
The Ayurmana operates as part of Kumarakom Lake Resort — check the resort’s booking desk or official site for package dates, programme inclusions and medical screening requirements.

latest.text: Kumarakom Lake Resort published exclusive Ayurveda packages with stated validity from 01 April 2026 to 30 September 2026 on the Ayurmana pages (check current package dates before booking).

Kumarakom Lake Resort (the hotel that houses Ayurmana) was named 'Kerala's Leading Resort 2025' at the World Travel Awards, reinforcing its profile as an award‑winning heritage property with an established Ayurveda centre.

visitorInfo.bestTime: September–March (cool, drier months) for comfortable therapy stays and backwater activities.
visitorInfo.howToReach: Kumarakom Lake Resort sits in Kumarakom (Kottayam district). Nearest major railhead is Kottayam (approx 18–25 km); Cochin International Airport (COK) is about 80–90 km. Resort transfer or local taxi is the usual option—confirm transfers with the hotel.
etiquette: Book physician consultation and longer Panchakarma programmes well in advance; some therapies need medical screening.
Ask which therapies are included in a package and whether post‑therapy diet guidance is provided; follow the resort’s pre‑ and post‑treatment advice.
If you have chronic medical conditions or take medication, share full medical history with the Ayurmana physician before treatment.
Confirm current package dates, availability and any seasonal offers on the resort’s website before you travel.
